title: HyperNeRF · 交互高维空间可视化主页

description.zh: 把抽象高维表示设计成可移动坐标与对应渲染的交互演示；预览来自作者网页交互区，而非整页截图。
description.en: An interactive higher-dimensional representation explorer couples a controllable coordinate to a rendered view; thumbnail is a source demo asset.

zh: 展示抽象潜变量、交互式参数影响或非刚性 3D 表示的科研网页。
en: Communicating abstract latent parameters, 3D variation and responsive model demonstrations on a project site.

zh: 抽象坐标和真实结果并排，交互控件承担解释变量的作用；比静态架构图更有助于建立直觉。
en: Pair a parameter-space widget with a synchronized rendered scene; interaction becomes part of the scientific explanation.

zh: 源图不包含交互行为；不要用单帧素材替代对官网 JS 动画、可访问性及实际运行的审查。
en: A single frame cannot substitute for testing the original interactive widget and its actual behavior.
